messages:
Maya: hey all, Maya here (started today) — trying to quickly map who to ping for stuff so i don't spam. quick list: 1) who owns routing/fallback rules? 2) who approves Dedicated console access / quota bumps? 3) who gets paged for latency spikes vs bad model outputs (hallucinations)? any tiny cheat-sheet or form i can copy? thanks! :wave:

Sam (onboarding-buddy): welcome Maya! short answers: routing/fallback = eng-platform. Dedicated access & quota = IT + eng-ops/finance approval. Page eng-sre oncall for any P1/P0 incidents. For clear model-quality issues (bad completions) @eng-ml owns triage.

eng-sre-bot: Paging rules summary: P0/P1 -> eng-sre oncall (pagerduty). eng-sre triages and will escalate to eng-platform (capacity/routing), eng-runtime (OOMs, batching), or eng-ml (quality). Always tag #customer-impact for anything user-facing. Runbooks: /playbooks/paging.md

Ops-Team: extra: if you need a quota bump include expected QPS + duration and business justification. Capacity requests route to eng-ops + finance; approver list is in /handbook/capacity-requests.md.

IT-bot: Access template (paste into IT ticket):
```
Subject: Access Request: Dedicated Console - maya@example.com
Requester: Maya (maya@example.com)
Manager: <manager-name>
Role: Engineer
Environment: staging/prod
Requested Okta group: redwood-dedicated-users
Reason: Onboarding + need to monitor routing and test fallbacks for feature Z
Expected peak QPS: 75
Temp access: 48h (optional)
Approvers: manager + eng-ops
```

Priya: tiny tip: if you plan to run routing experiments, open a one-paragraph RFC in #eng-platform and include a rollback window. eng-platform prefers a short changelog entry when you modify fallback rules.

Maya: filed IT ticket and added manager, thanks everyone! i'll read the linked playbooks and DM if i get stuck. :sparkles:
